summary: Iter 248 — E2E validation of session-start reminder, duplicate-prevention, pre-approval auditor notes, Arabic historical queries, and regressions. 10/10 backend pytest tests PASS; 5/5 frontend flows PASS (login for احمد1/فرج1/مدير, Katrina drawer reminder with 3 ApprovalCards, approver reject-from-chat).
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate prevention check uses action+entity+amount+pending filter — solid and returns the existing ApprovalCard with a clear ♻️ header. No new pending draft created (confirmed via pending count before/after).
Pre-approval auditor block (🕵️ ملاحظات المدقق قبل الاعتماد) is included on the FIRST creation of a draft but NOT re-shown on the dedup response — good UX, avoids noise.

Session-start reminder correctly filters approvals awaiting THIS approver's decision (احمد1 sees مدير's drafts, not his own) and renders up to 3 ApprovalCards in chat with live approve/reject buttons.
GET /api/runtime/approvals returns {success, data:[...]} — inconsistent with plain list expectation in a few older tests. Consider standardising or documenting; new tests handle both shapes.

Approve endpoint expects the outer approval `id` (not `draft_id`). Chat responses do expose `executed.id` but that maps to draft_id — confusing naming. Consider renaming or including both explicitly in tool_results for downstream consumers.
test_credentials: name-only login: مدير (admin/approver), احمد1 (supervisor/approver), فرج1 (accountant/no-approve). See /app/memory/test_credentials.md
seed_data_creation: Test purchases created with unique amounts (60-89 range for dup test, 100-599 for four-eyes) and cancelled via contextual cancel where possible; a rejected legacy card via the frontend reminder-reject flow also occurred (planned - one draft by مدير was rejected by احمد1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: GET /api/runtime/approvals?status=pending returns {success:true, data:[{id, draft_id, requester, status, payload:{...}}]}. Approve endpoint uses outer `id`. Chat is at POST /api/assistant/chat with {message, session_id, language}; response wrapped {success, data:{response, tool_results, ...}}. Duplicate detection triggers ♻️ **طلب مطابق معلق بالفعل** message. Auditor block shown only on first-time creation. Reminder detected via '🔔' or 'تذكير' in response text. Drawer testids: unified-assistant-fab, assistant-input, assistant-send-btn, [data-testid^='assistant-card-ApprovalCard']. LLM replies take 10-40s.
